descripcion: TERCERA PUERTA. Entrega una muerte confirmada. La misma regla que el 38: lo que la puerta da, lo da siempre; lo que se elige es cuanto mas se quiere saber.
_por_que_no_otorga_prueba: No otorga broad_street_racimo: esa la gana el jugador al cercar el plano.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

abre.texto: Who is it? I am not opening the door to anyone.

death.texto: My apprentice. He was only seventeen. He died before dawn on Friday, in the room behind the shop. And my wife, Elizabeth, on Thursday.

opciones.texto: Do you know what made him ill?

si_albert.texto: Yes. Albert. He was a good boy.

sin_nombre.texto: Please, Reverend. I cannot say his name yet.

fear.texto: The air from the street. It gets in under the door. So I keep it shut, with rags in every crack.

opciones.texto: Where did the boy fetch water from?

agua.texto: From the Broad Street pump, for the shop. Ten times a day, in this heat.

opciones.texto: Where did the boy fetch water from?

presenta.texto: Henry Whitehead, from St Luke's. I saw the black ribbon on your door.

entreabre.texto: Reverend. Forgive me. I will open it a little, but please stay outside.

_pivote: No sabe el nombre del chico (lo da la carbonera). Elizabeth es distractor.
_reescrito: Whitehead pregunta porque vio el lazo; el sastre no lo suelta solo.
